name: Sandisk Corporation
research_rationale: No new headlines since the last run; filing-backed profits and cash still sit against unresolved NAND cyclical and sentiment risks, so research keeps weakening the strong-buy screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
GF Securities’s 2027 NAND glut warning dragged Sandisk with Micron; press frames it as the most NAND-exposed name.
Duquesne’s 13F showed a full exit before 30 September; the 8-for-1 split is scheduled for 19 November.
Memory names remain volatile on AI-demand fears; bullish NAND notes (e.g. Evercore) sit alongside sharp recent share losses.

Press contrasts brisk AI data-centre NAND sales with falling shares and political/regulatory fears hitting memory stocks.
After-hours chip names firmed on Nvidia’s earnings beat; the batch adds no new SNDK filings or company disclosures.
